title: Ten tips for growing tomatoes on a balcony
paragraphs: Tomatoes are one of the easiest vegetables to grow in containers, as long as they get at least six hours of direct sun. Choose a pot that holds at least five gallons of soil and has drainage holes, and pick a compact variety such as a cherry or patio tomato.

Water deeply and regularly. Containers dry out faster than garden beds, so check the soil with a finger each morning. Uneven watering causes split fruit and blossom end rot, so aim for steady moisture rather than occasional soaking.
